analysis.reasonEn: Closed positive for 3 consecutive sessions, RSI at 72.0 entering overbought territory, MACD histogram improvement continues, and volume surge (2.79x average) strengthens upward momentum. Still at a low 9.1% of 52-week range. Trading below SMA200 (-4.52%) but above EMA50 (17.52%) confirming short-term strength. Weekly ADX at 27.8 indicates a clear trend. 4H RSI at 80.8 also overbought. Observing potential short-term pullback due to overbought conditions, hence the wait-and-see approach.

analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]
· Current price ($0.21) vs SMA5 ($0.19)/SMA20 ($0.19)/SMA50 ($0.18) — trading above short- to mid-term trends, confirming uptrend.
· Position relative to SMA100 ($0.19)/SMA200 ($0.22) — below mid- to long-term trends, indicating short-term strength against longer-term weakness.
· 52-week position (9.1%) + current price range historically low.
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI trajectory (44.2→72.0) + entered overbought territory, strengthening upward momentum.
· MACD histogram trajectory (-0.0024→0.0015) + continuous improvement, signaling bullish trend reversal.
· Bollinger Band current price position (Upper band $0.21) + approaching upper band, entering overheated zone.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing support ($0.16) + supported by Pivot S1 ($0.18) and SMA50 ($0.18).
· Swing resistance ($0.27) + potential for further upside on breakout.
· 5-day/20-day high/low pattern (Higher Low) + uptrend continuation.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume ratio (2.79x) + increased confidence in price movement.
· Current phase diagnosis (Uptrend) + considering potential pullback due to short-term overheating, meeting conditions for observation.
